subject: Correction required for ledger entry VEN031-0019
body:
Dear Accounts lead,

Record VEN031-0019 is booked Rs 19,119 away from the invoice total. The invoice dated 18 Sep 2025 for Rs 1,25,336 shows a ledger entry of Rs 1,06,217. Please correct the ledger entry so it equals the invoice total.
